data.gender_notes: Myrtie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Myrtie is derived from the name of the myrtle tree, which symbolizes love and prosperity. In the Bible, myrtle branches are used to decorate the Tabernacle and the Temple in Jerusalem, and are mentioned in the Song of Solomon as a symbol of love and beauty. The name Myrtie carries the meaning “Myrtle tree” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Myrtie usually hope their child will grow to embody myrtle tree and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Myrtie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Myrtle tree.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Myrtie total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
